description: A Unix timestamp converter — timestamps to dates, and dates back to timestamps. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

timeZone.description: IANA zone name, e.g. "Europe/Copenhagen", used for the local reading and the day of the week. Defaults to UTC, and an unknown name falls back to UTC rather than failing.

value.description: A Unix timestamp or a date. A bare number is read as seconds, or as milliseconds once it reaches 100000000000 (1e11); negative means before 1970. Anything else is parsed as a date string such as 2026-08-03T12:00:00Z.

name: timestamp_converter
title: Timestamp Converter
